thread:
Customer Support: @eng-security heads up — BooksCo sent a SOC2 evidence request. They want KMS key rotation proof, audit log extracts (last 90 days), a sanitized SBOM, and remediation ETAs for three flagged deps: OpenSSL (CVE-2026-0456), protobuf (CVE-2025-8890), fastjson (CVE-2025-3101). They asked for a response by EOD Friday. Link: https://booksco.example/req/8421 :rotating_light:
Elaine: assigning owners — Jordan for KMS/audit logs, Sam for SBOM & dependency triage. I'll own the customer response. :clipboard:
Jordan: on it. For KMS rotation history I'll pull Cloud KMS metadata. Example command I’ll run: `gcloud kms keys get-rotation-schedule --location=global --keyring=redwood-prod --key=svc-data` and `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"v1.KeyRings.UpdateCryptoKey\"" --limit 1000`
Sam: SBOM is in s3 as CycloneDX JSON v1.4: `s3://redwood-compliance/sboms/sbom-2026-02-12.json`. I’ll sanitize PII and internal repo names. Quick triage: protobuf CVE-2025-8890 — low exploitability in our builds; fastjson used only in analytics pipeline; OpenSSL CVE-2026-0456 looks risky for runtime if our base image bundles an affected lib.
Marta: clarifying — fastjson is not in inference runtime, only batch analytics and ETL. Should be lower priority for immediate customer-facing risk.
Jordan: audit logs note — some resource logs already have 180-day retention, but I can export a filtered 90-day slice. Plan: export to GCS, generate CSV with rotation events and key IDs, redact ARNs where necessary. ETA ~24 hours.
Elaine: triage plan (short): 1) confirm CVSS + exploitability; 2) map to runtime vs infra; 3) patch/backport or mitigate; 4) assemble evidence bundle. Who owns CVE-2026-0456? @Sam? :eyes:
Sam: I’ll take OpenSSL and fastjson upgrades. OpenSSL backport PoC done in staging. fastjson upgrade to 2.0.9 landed in analytics/staging. ETA for prod patch 6h after approvals.
DevBot: Deploy pipeline triggered for branch `hotfix/openssl-2026-0456` — build #4521.
Jordan: small blocker — need logs viewing permission to export rotation events for some projects. @Ops can you grant `roles/logging.viewer` to `eng-security-exporter@redwood-prod` on `projects/redwood-prod-compliance`?
Ops: granted `roles/logging.viewer` on the compliance project to `eng-security-exporter`. Also created GCS bucket `redwood-compliance-temp-booksco-1764507890` with restricted access. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: thanks. Note: we can only provide rotation metadata (timestamps, key IDs, rotation schedule). We cannot share key material or unredacted customer CMK names. Will redact ARNs as necessary.
Customer Support: BooksCo replied — they accept redacted artifacts as long as rotation timestamps, log entries, and patch SHAs are included in the bundle. They prefer download links.
Sam: PRs created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 (openssl backport), https://github.com/redwood-inference/analytics/pull/1023 (fastjson -> 2.0.9). OpenSSL staging smoke tests passing.
Marta: protobuf CVE-2025-8890 validated — not present in inference container images; only in internal dev tooling. Marking low impact for customer runtime.
Jordan: uploaded audit CSV to `gs://redwood-compliance-temp-booksco-1764507890/kms-rotation-90d.csv` and set read link TTL 7 days. Will send signed URL to CS.
Elaine: assembling response bundle: 1) KMS rotation CSV (redacted), 2) audit log export link, 3) sanitized SBOM (CycloneDX v1.4), 4) CVE triage doc with CVSS, exploitability notes, patch SHAs & PR links, 5) planned timeline. Draft ETA 36 hours.
Customer Support: forwarding to BooksCo — they acknowledged and will wait for the bundle. Thanks team. :pray:
Elaine: follow-ups: Sam to confirm prod deploy time for OpenSSL, Jordan to confirm GCS signed URL, Sam to attach PR SHAs in triage doc, Marta to finalize runtime exposure note. I’ll update SOC2 evidence tracker and close the loop with the customer once bundle is uploaded.
Sam: prod deploy scheduled after approvals — target +6 hours.
Jordan: shared signed URL: https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-compliance-temp-booksco-1764507890/kms-rotation-90d.csv?X-Goog-SignedHeaders=...
Elaine: great work. I’ll send the draft response to CS for review before we hand off to BooksCo. :tada:
